chapters.title: I · Roots of Industry
chapters.subtitle: Algal binder, rotation and your first workshop

quests.title: A kingdom starts small
description: Welcome to T&K3. Build compact production lines, explore, and grow a settlement. Main quests follow the workshop spine; side branches are optional. Machine possession is detected; automation checkmarks are self-reported.

quests.title: A living binder
description: Grow kelp. Combine one kelp and one clay ball into two Algal Blend. Mixing doubles the yield once your workshop is running.

quests.title: Algal Blend
description: Use the real Architect’s Palette item. One andesite plus one blend makes two alloy by hand or four in a mixer.

quests.title: Andesite Alloy
description: Start manually; improve your material yield with a mixer later. Shafts, cogs and casings retain native recipes.

quests.title: Kinetic Mechanism
description: Sequence a wooden slab through two separate Andesite Alloy deployments and finish with a BetterEnd Iron Hammer. One loop, one guaranteed mechanism. Mechanisms have no handcrafting route: start by crafting the first machine frame from raw materials.

quests.title: Turn the wheel
description: Use the stonecutting recipe: kubejs:tk3_kinetic_machine → 3x create:water_wheel. Follow the recipe viewer for the exact pattern and conditions.

quests.title: Your first press
description: Use the stonecutting recipe: kubejs:tk3_kinetic_machine → create:mechanical_press. Follow the recipe viewer for the exact pattern and conditions.

quests.title: Mix, don’t grind
description: Use the stonecutting recipe: kubejs:tk3_kinetic_machine → create:mechanical_mixer. Follow the recipe viewer for the exact pattern and conditions.

quests.title: Air changes materials
description: Use the stonecutting recipe: kubejs:tk3_kinetic_machine → create:encased_fan. Follow the recipe viewer for the exact pattern and conditions.

quests.title: Automate assembly
description: Build a Deployer from a Kinetic Machine in a stonecutter. On a belt or depot, deploy one Andesite Alloy onto a wooden slab, deploy a second alloy, then use a deployer holding an Iron Hammer. Ordinary hammers lose one durability; the chapter reward does not.

quests.title: A renewable workshop
description: Use the stonecutting recipe: kubejs:tk3_kinetic_machine → create:mechanical_saw. Follow the recipe viewer for the exact pattern and conditions.

quests.title: Stone into iron
description: Cobble → gravel (mill) → iron nuggets (native fan washing) → ingots. Native washing is probabilistic; this is a compact renewable route, not an ore replacement.

quests.title: Lay your foundations
description: MineColonies is the selected kingdom system. Start a settlement beside the workshop; colony supply requests will later benefit from Create logistics.

quests.title: Milestone · The workshop runs
description: Have a functioning wheel, press, mixer/basin and deployer. Confirm after producing alloy and rotation mechanisms on your line. Unlocks chapter II machines for your team. Reward: unbreakable Workshop Hammer. Install it in the finishing deployer; it accepts the same recipe as the ordinary tool and removes replacement maintenance.

quests.title: Kinetic Machine
description: Manual startup: seven Andesite Alloy, one wooden slab and one Andesite Casing. Pattern: AAA / ACA / ASA. Automated: deploy one Kinetic Mechanism onto one Andesite Casing. Stonecut the frame into a water wheel, press, basin, mixer or deployer.

quests.title: A geological worksite
description: Build the working setup described by this quest. Follow the player guide for the resource generator or machine arrangement.

tasks.title: Controleer dat de beschreven opstelling werkt

quests.title: Timber without exceptions
description: Use the stonecutting recipe: kubejs:tk3_kinetic_machine → create:mechanical_saw. Follow the recipe viewer for the exact pattern and conditions.

quests.title: A modest storage upgrade
description: Upgrade Base gebruikt iron sheets, planks en 1 Kinetic Mechanism. Native basiskisten en barrels blijven goedkoop. Neem je inhoud mee via native component-behoudende tier recipes.

quests.title: Tools of the workshop · Workshop Hammer
description: Craft an ordinary betterend:iron_hammer. It is the final deployer-held tool for this chapter’s mechanism sequence. Use normal tools to finish the chapter; claim the named unbreakable version at the milestone and replace the tool in your deployer.

chapters.title: II · Copperworks
chapters.subtitle: Sealed assembly, tanks and fluid handling

quests.title: Flatten copper
description: Press copper ingots. This is the first layer that needs an actual processing machine.

quests.title: Renewable sealant
description: Mix one kelp and one wheat with 250 mB water into two slimeballs. Natural slime is also valid; no mandatory rubber mod.

quests.title: Sealed Mechanism
description: Kinetic Mechanism → deploy copper sheet → deploy slimeball → deploy with a Farmer’s Delight Iron Knife. One loop; the knife finishes the seal and loses one durability instead of being consumed.

quests.title: Direct the flow
description: Use the stonecutting recipe: kubejs:tk3_hydraulic_machine → 16x create:fluid_pipe. Follow the recipe viewer for the exact pattern and conditions.

quests.title: Move water
description: Use the stonecutting recipe: kubejs:tk3_hydraulic_machine → create:mechanical_pump. Follow the recipe viewer for the exact pattern and conditions.

quests.title: Buffer fluids
description: Use the stonecutting recipe: kubejs:tk3_hydraulic_machine → 3x create:fluid_tank. Follow the recipe viewer for the exact pattern and conditions.

quests.title: Fill on the line
description: Use the stonecutting recipe: kubejs:tk3_hydraulic_machine → create:spout. Follow the recipe viewer for the exact pattern and conditions.

quests.title: Recover fluids
description: Use the stonecutting recipe: kubejs:tk3_hydraulic_machine → create:item_drain. Follow the recipe viewer for the exact pattern and conditions.

quests.title: Reach a reservoir
description: Use the stonecutting recipe: kubejs:tk3_hydraulic_machine → create:hose_pulley. Follow the recipe viewer for the exact pattern and conditions.

quests.title: Expand rotational power
description: Use the stonecutting recipe: kubejs:tk3_hydraulic_machine → create:steam_engine. Follow the recipe viewer for the exact pattern and conditions.

quests.title: Wires for later
description: Prepare native copper wire/spools for the FE transition. Alternators and motors remain locked until chapter V.

quests.title: Milestone · A sealed production line
description: Run the sealed-mechanism sequence and maintain a working fluid buffer. Confirm after the line works. Unlocks brass logistics and precision machines. Reward: unbreakable Sealwright Knife. Install it in the finishing deployer; it accepts the same recipe as the ordinary tool and removes replacement maintenance.

quests.title: Hydraulic Machine
description: Place a Copper Casing on a belt or depot and deploy one Sealed Mechanism onto it. Stonecut the resulting frame into sixteen pipes, three tanks, or one pump/spout.

quests.title: Copperworks geology
description: Onder de steen: lens, daaronder Hydraulic Machine. Netherrack → scoria/redstone; blackstone → scorchia/coal; copper block → veridium/copper; iron block → crimsite/iron. Mill voor de eerste materialen. Crushing is pas tier 3.

tasks.title: Controleer dat de beschreven opstelling werkt

quests.title: Tools of the workshop · Sealwright Knife
description: Craft an ordinary farmersdelight:iron_knife. It is the final deployer-held tool for this chapter’s mechanism sequence. Use normal tools to finish the chapter; claim the named unbreakable version at the milestone and replace the tool in your deployer.

chapters.title: III · Brass & Precision
chapters.subtitle: Heated metallurgy, deterministic assembly and organised logistics

quests.title: Bring heat home
description: Travel to the Nether and capture a blaze in an empty blaze burner. Blaze rods detect exploration; burner operation must be checked in your factory.

quests.title: Brass metallurgy
description: Heated mixing: one copper plus one zinc → two brass ingots. Farm blaze fuel before relying on the line.

quests.title: Redstone into control
description: Native rose quartz, polishing and electron tube recipes remain. Craft sandpaper or automate polishing.

quests.title: Precision without scrap
description: Sealed Mechanism → deploy brass sheet → deploy Electron Tube → deploy with Create Sand Paper. One loop and one guaranteed Precision Mechanism. Ordinary paper loses one durability; chapter III awards a permanent abrasive.

quests.title: Route with purpose
description: Use the stonecutting recipe: kubejs:tk3_precision_machine → 6x create:brass_funnel. Follow the recipe viewer for the exact pattern and conditions.

quests.title: Handle exact ingredients
description: Use the stonecutting recipe: kubejs:tk3_precision_machine → create:mechanical_arm. Follow the recipe viewer for the exact pattern and conditions.

quests.title: Mechanical crafting
description: Use the stonecutting recipe: kubejs:tk3_precision_machine → 3x create:mechanical_crafter. Follow the recipe viewer for the exact pattern and conditions.

quests.title: Create logistics
description: Use the stonecutting recipe: kubejs:tk3_precision_machine → create:packager. Follow the recipe viewer for the exact pattern and conditions.

quests.title: Order from the workshop
description: Use the stonecutting recipe: kubejs:tk3_precision_machine → create:stock_ticker. Follow the recipe viewer for the exact pattern and conditions.

quests.title: Recover experience
description: Native experience fluids stay intact. Advanced enchanting waits for chapter IV.

quests.title: A first propeller
description: An optional Aeronautics bridge. Follow installed Ponder documentation; full ship-building and levitite balance are outside these five chapters.

quests.title: Milestone · Precision at scale
description: Operate a brass/precision production line with controlled item routing. Unlocks arcane production devices. Reward: unbreakable Precision Abrasive. Install it in the finishing deployer; it accepts the same recipe as the ordinary tool and removes replacement maintenance.

quests.title: Precision Machine
description: Deploy one Precision Mechanism onto one Brass Casing. Stonecut the frame into arms, crafters and smart logistics.

quests.title: A crushing improvement
description: Use the mechanical crafting recipe: kubejs:tk3_precision_machine + create:andesite_alloy + #minecraft:planks → 2x create:crushing_wheel. Follow the recipe viewer for the exact pattern and conditions.

quests.title: Tools of the workshop · Precision Abrasive
description: Craft an ordinary create:sand_paper. It is the final deployer-held tool for this chapter’s mechanism sequence. Use normal tools to finish the chapter; claim the named unbreakable version at the milestone and replace the tool in your deployer.

chapters.title: IV · Arcane Industry
chapters.subtitle: Living source, haunting and the Wilden trial

quests.title: Meet the arcane
description: Early combat magic remains available. This chapter unlocks industrial magic rather than requiring everyone to choose a spellcaster class.

quests.title: Imbue materials
description: Native recipe, available before chapter IV so early combat magic can obtain Source Gems. Use it again here for industrial essences.

quests.title: The apparatus
description: Craft one Precision Machine, one diamond and one Source Gem into an Enchanting Apparatus. Native Imbuement Chamber and Source Jar remain available. Native Volcanic/Vitalic Sourcelinks supply the first Source before your Arcane Machine.

quests.title: Soul-fire transformation
description: Haunt source gems using a fan blowing through soul fire. This adds a renewable combat-magic ingredient without adding a custom dust.

quests.title: Magic with purpose
description: Use the installed native Ars essence recipe. Its native imbuement recipe is preserved.

quests.title: Arcane Mechanism
description: Precision Mechanism → deploy Source Gem → deploy Arcane Essence → deploy Manipulation Essence → deploy gold ingot → finish with a deployer holding an Ars Enchanter’s Sword. One loop, guaranteed output. Craft the ordinary sword first using its native apparatus recipe.

quests.title: Source from living systems
description: Grow crops near the agronomic sourcelink and store Source in native Source Jars. Native jar recipes remain.

quests.title: A living courier
description: Create handles processing and bulk movement; starbuncles handle small local transfers.

quests.title: A magical farm
description: An optional living farm; keep Create infrastructure for physical processing.

quests.title: Ink from the workshop
description: Mix ink sac + arcane essence + 250 mB water → two common ink. Higher rarities keep native recipes and combat/exploration progression.

quests.title: Combat-magic chemistry
description: Use native brewing recipes. No speculative cauldron-fluid serializer is added in this release.

quests.title: The Wilden trial
description: Summon and defeat the Wilden Chimera using the native Ars challenge ritual. This kill is detected; obtaining a gifted tribute alone does not satisfy the task.

quests.title: A permanent physical catalyst
description: Keep the tribute. A deployer later applies it to a steel casing to create the metallurgic infuser without consuming it.

quests.title: Milestone · Magic powers industry
description: Maintain Source generation and produce an arcane mechanism. The detected boss kill plus this milestone unlocks chapter V industry. Reward: unbreakable Arcane Engraver. Install it in the finishing deployer; it accepts the same recipe as the ordinary tool and removes replacement maintenance.

quests.title: Arcane Machine
description: Apparatus: Brass Casing as reagent, Source Gem + Arcane Essence + gold on pedestals, 500 Source → Wizardry Arcane Casing. Then deploy one Arcane Mechanism onto that casing. Use the frame for Source devices, automation charms and Wizardry machines.

quests.title: Runes meet machinery
description: Compacting stone + Arcane Essence maakt Blank Rune. Ars fire/water/air/earth essence + Arcane Mechanism via apparatus maakt de vier basale element-runes. Combat glyphs en hogere spell progressie behouden native routes.

quests.title: Tools of the workshop · Arcane Engraver
description: Craft an ordinary ars_nouveau:enchanters_sword. It is the final deployer-held tool for this chapter’s mechanism sequence. Use normal tools to finish the chapter; claim the named unbreakable version at the milestone and replace the tool in your deployer.

chapters.title: V · The Industrial Bridge
chapters.subtitle: Steel, FE and basic Mekanism processing

quests.title: Steel without a dead end
description: Heated mixer: two iron ingots plus one coal → two steel ingots. The native Mekanism steel chain remains as an alternative after bootstrap.

quests.title: Explore for osmium
description: Mine and smelt native osmium. Resource ore generation is unchanged; discovery still matters.

quests.title: The industrial casing
description: 5 steel ingots + 2 osmium ingots + 1 Precision Machine + 1 Arcane Machine. Geen FE nodig voor de casing; bouw daarna heat generator en kabels.

quests.title: First FE power
description: Steel casing + furnace + precision mechanism. Follow native lava/fuel mechanics. Start small; advanced generation is later.

quests.title: Boss catalyst, preserved
description: Deploy a Wilden Tribute onto a steel casing. The held tribute is kept. Feed power and native infusion materials.

quests.title: Infused alloys
description: Native redstone infusion of iron. Chemistry starts here; atomic materials and later factories remain locked.

quests.title: Refine with power
description: Casing + infused alloy + precision mechanism. Added raw iron/copper enrichment yields two dust per raw item.

quests.title: Reliable iron doubling
description: Raw iron → two iron dust → two ingots. No ore → block conversion multiplier is added.

quests.title: Close the refining loop
description: Casing + furnace + precision mechanism. Native dust smelting remains. Feed the line without creating a crafting loop.

quests.title: A compact FE grid
description: Use basic cables only. Higher transport tiers, factories and QIO belong to later chapters.

quests.title: Rotation becomes FE
description: Casing + copper spool + precision mechanism. Native conversion efficiencies are unchanged; verify net loss in the real instance.

quests.title: FE becomes rotation
description: Casing + capacitor + precision mechanism. Alternator and motor become available together at tier V; measure the loop to confirm no energy gain.

quests.title: Basic industrial logistics
description: Short-range basic pipes are now available. Create remains the workshop backbone; late transport upgrades remain locked.

quests.title: Milestone · An industrial kingdom
description: Operate powered enrichment and smelting beside your Create workshop. Five-chapter baseline complete. AE2, factories, advanced chemistry and End gates continue in later chapters and stay locked in this package. Reward: a second unbreakable Iron Hammer for a parallel kinetic assembly line. Tier 6 remains locked.

quests.title: Storage grows with industry
description: Use the wrapped recipe: sophisticatedstorage:stack_upgrade_tier_1 + mekanism:steel_casing + mekanism:alloy_infused → sophisticatedstorage:stack_upgrade_tier_2. Follow the recipe viewer for the exact pattern and conditions.

assembly_tools.ordinary: One durability per completed tool step

assembly_tools.ordinary: One durability per completed tool step

notes: All directly referenced Create inputs have an authored recipe or a named natural stone source.
Ore mining, worldgen stones, capturing blazes, fluids and decorative block families keep their deliberate native acquisition.
Reset recipes are explicitly retained; other recipes for controlled outputs are removed by the final whitelist.
No new custom item or block registries.
